recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy black-and-white close-up portrait of a woman's face, cropped to show one eye and a cascade of micro-braids. The image is framed by a soft, curved beige border on the left, with text elements placed in the upper left and lower center.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical texture of the braids contrasts with the smooth skin tones.
The sharp focus on the eye acts as the primary focal point against the grainy background.
The organic, fluid lower text balances the rigid, spaced-out upper serif text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is scaled to fill the right two-thirds of the frame, with the eye positioned in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's right eye, which is the only feature in sharp focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the sharp eye, follows the braids downward to the lower text, and then moves to the upper left text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A curved beige sliver on the far left provides breathing room and a container for the secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Grayscale tones ranging from deep black in the hair to bright highlights on the skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks provide structural contrast against the mid-tone grain.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted beige (hex #C4B7A9) used for the border and lower text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation in the primary image; low saturation in the accent color; high value contrast.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Humanist serif and organic calligraphic script
letterConstructionRules: Upper text uses wide tracking and high-contrast serifs.
Lower text features fluid, continuous strokes with varying weights and flared terminals.
Lowercase 'b' and 'd' in the script have elongated, slightly curved ascenders.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'y' in the script has a sharp, diagonal tail that cuts back toward the left.
The 'a' in the script has an open counter and a soft, rounded bowl.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, spaced-out serif and a fluid, lowercase script.

preserve: Wide tracking in the upper text
Lowercase script for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and sharp serifs for the upper text.
The lower text has unique, non-standard terminals and flow.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-grain, black and white close-up portrait of a woman with micro-braids, focusing on one eye. Include a curved beige border on the left side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a lowercase organic script at the bottom center in beige. Add the secondary title in a stacked, wide-tracked uppercase serif in the top left corner in black.

verificationChecks: Is the eye the sharpest point of the image?
Is the script text lowercase and beige?
Is the serif text uppercase with wide tracking?

adjustableVariables: Width of the left beige border
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Brandy'
Do not use the specific title 'Never Say Never'
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the eye.
Check that the beige tone is consistent between the border and the script.
Verify the grain does not muddy the facial details.
Confirm the tracking on the upper text is significantly wide.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-grain monochrome macro portrait with a curved color-block border and a pairing of wide-tracked serifs and fluid, earthy-toned script.
